Name: accent
Used for: Links, focus outlines, selected buttons, and the third level of tentacles

Name: bg
Used for: Page background. A light one switches form controls and scrollbars to light too

Name: surface
Used for: Cards, panels and dropdowns, code blocks, and the dimmed background behind pop-ups

Name: surface-raised
Used for: Outlines of summary boxes, Dashboard tiles, form fields and dropdowns, Timeline bars with no milestones, hover backgrounds, raised controls, plus buttons (other than on project pages), the second colour of the logo, and top-level tentacles (lightened towards the text colour)

Name: border
Used for: Borders and archived labels

Name: text
Used for: Main text and faint divider lines. Highlight colours are lightened towards it on hover

Name: text-soft
Used for: Secondary and quiet text, UNASSIGNED status, and tentacles below the third level

Name: shadow-colour
Used for: Drop shadows and sunken areas

Name: on-highlight
Used for: Text and ticks drawn on a filled highlight colour, such as milestone tiles and the Review count

Name: complete
Used for: Complete milestones, active projects, DONE status, priority A, and Review or Plan being due

Name: caution
Used for: Milestones in progress, WAITING status, priority B, the last item in a milestone on the Plan page, Review or Plan due soon, and warnings

Name: pending
Used for: Milestones not started, inactive projects, ASSIGNED status, and unexpected files on Compatibility

Name: alert
Used for: Milestones with no tasks, priority C, sidebar items whose project is not active, errors and delete buttons

Name: tentacle
Used for: Sidebar items named in the latest focus, tentacles to review and their review flag, booked events, and the second level of tentacles

Name: project
Used for: Sidebar items whose project is in the latest focus, Suggested projects on the Plan page, projects to review and their review flag, application deadlines, and the plus buttons and fact boxes on project pages

Name: print-paper
Used for: The page colour of a printed report

Name: print-ink
Used for: Main text on a printed report

Name: print-ink-soft
Used for: Secondary text on a printed report

Name: print-line
Used for: Lines and borders on a printed report

Name: print-raised
Used for: Outlines of boxes and tiles on a printed report
